name: load_run_add
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 42
description: Real Method declaration captures scope/body and executes Add/Return

name: owned_source_copy
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 42
description: Mutating caller input after prepare does not replace owned method bytes

name: nested_method
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 42
description: Method arity and both captured source spans feed nested call

name: cross_scope_alias
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 11
description: Alias invocation resolves X from declaration D0, not invocation alias D1

name: alias_original_rebound
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 11
description: Original declaration scope survives source Name rebinding after Alias

name: method_redeclaration
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 33
description: Fresh method ID gets new observation; old alias retains old body and observation

name: serialized_boundary
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::UnresolvedSynchronization
description: Loader captures flags; executor explicitly rejects serialized method

name: source_unit_mismatch
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::SourceUnit
description: Mismatched retained source unit is rejected before byte execution

name: method_payload_mismatch
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::MethodDefinition
description: Changed live Method payload does not silently rewrite captured observation

name: maximum_source_unit
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && result.value.initialized && result.value.number == 42
description: Opaque u64 maximum source identity remains exact data

name: rollback_unsupported
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::UnsupportedSyntax && !program.loaded && program.store.space.object_count == 0 && !program.definitions.entries[0].present && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::InvalidState
description: Failed static load rolls namespace and captured definitions back; failed program cannot execute

name: rollback_after_capture
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::WorkLimit && !program.loaded && program.store.space.object_count == 0 && !program.definitions.entries[0].present && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::InvalidState
description: Failed static load rolls namespace and captured definitions back; failed program cannot execute

name: zero_load_budget
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::WorkLimit && !program.loaded && program.store.space.object_count == 0 && !program.definitions.entries[0].present && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::InvalidState
description: Failed static load rolls namespace and captured definitions back; failed program cannot execute

name: input_capacity
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Capacity && !prepared.program.loaded && !prepared.program.definitions.entries[0].present
description: Capacity rejection does not install namespace or method observations

name: input_maximum
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Capacity && !prepared.program.loaded && !prepared.program.definitions.entries[0].present
description: Capacity rejection does not install namespace or method observations

name: budget_maximum
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Capacity && !prepared.program.loaded && !prepared.program.definitions.entries[0].present
description: Capacity rejection does not install namespace or method observations

name: last_object_slot
check: initial.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && loaded.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && loaded.load.space.object_count == 64 && loaded.definitions.entries[63].present && loaded.definitions.entries[63].object_id == 63
description: Fresh Method slot63 is usable; later allocation failure rolls it and its observation back

name: object_capacity_rollback
check: initial.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && loaded.load.outcome == Outcome::Capacity && loaded.load.space.object_count == 63 && !loaded.definitions.entries[63].present
description: Fresh Method slot63 is usable; later allocation failure rolls it and its observation back

name: occupied_observation_slot
check: loaded.load.outcome == Outcome::InvalidState && loaded.load.space.object_count == 0 && loaded.definitions.entries[0].present && loaded.definitions.entries[0].body.unit == 99
description: An occupied observation slot is rejected before committing the tentative namespace insertion; original sidecar is preserved

name: incremental_rollback
check: first.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && second.load.outcome == Outcome::UnsupportedSyntax && second.definitions.entries[0].present && second.definitions.entries[0].body.unit == 6 && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && !second.definitions.entries[1].present && result.value.number == 11
description: Lowlevel incremental loader preserves declaration observations; rollback retains callable prior source, while absent multiunit dispatch rejects calls into another source unit

name: incremental_source_unit
check: first.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && second.load.outcome == Outcome::Success && second.definitions.entries[0].present && second.definitions.entries[0].body.unit == 6 && result.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::SourceUnit && second.definitions.entries[1].present && second.definitions.entries[1].body.unit == 7
description: Lowlevel incremental loader preserves declaration observations; rollback retains callable prior source, while absent multiunit dispatch rejects calls into another source unit

name: persistent_namespace
check: prepared.outcome == Outcome::Success && first.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && first.value.number == 1 && second.outcome == ExecutionOutcome::Success && second.value.number == 2 && program.definitions.entries[1].present
description: Repeated calls mutate the retained namespace without reloading source or replacing observations
